title: Everspin Signs Deal With Microchip Technology to Boost Manufacturing
summary: Everspin Technologies has signed a long-term manufacturing agreement with Microchip Technology to expand onshore production capacity for MRAM and TMR sensor products. The partnership establishes a new MRAM manufacturing line at Microchip’s Oregon facility, strengthening U.S.-based semiconductor supply chain resilience and ensuring long-term production scalability through the 2030s.Learn more about the partnership: https://www.marketwatch.com/story/everspin-signs-deal-with-microchip-technology-to-boost-manufacturing-614ced20
body_markdown:
Everspin Technologies has signed a long-term manufacturing agreement with Microchip Technology to expand onshore production capacity for MRAM and TMR sensor products. The partnership establishes a new MRAM manufacturing line at Microchip’s Oregon facility, strengthening U.S.-based semiconductor supply chain resilience and ensuring long-term production scalability through the 2030s.


Learn more about the partnership: https://www.marketwatch.com/story/everspin-signs-deal-with-microchip-technology-to-boost-manufacturing-614ced20
